item.title: Version 0.1.1 (Build 2)
item.description:
• Bracketed paste: multi-line pastes no longer truncate at the first newline or leave the shell stuck in paste mode.
  • Remote workspaces: quitting no longer orphans forwarded ssh processes; a dropped forward auto-reconnects and panes re-attach with full replay.
  • Replay: query stripping preserves output split across snapshot chunks; parser replies stay suppressed through the entire replay (no more mode-2048 size reports leaking into the PTY).
  • Remote file download fixed — scp was receiving shell-quoted paths.

item.title: Version 0.1.0 (Build 1)
item.description:
• Initial public release.
  • - Native macOS terminal workbench: Ghostty core (libghostty), real AppKit chrome
  • - Sessions outlive the app via goty-sessiond (Rust) — quit, crash, or reboot; shells keep running
  • - Servers from ~/.ssh/config, each with its own remote daemon and parked sessions
  • - Agent awareness: Claude Code, Codex & co. — brand icons, live status, git context
  • - @ai inline card: streaming markdown, executable bash/write/edit proposals
  • - Themed by your own Ghostty config; Sparkle auto-updates
